# Real CVS fixtures

Real Contractor Visual Studio job package exports (`cvs.job-package` version 1), generated by the CVS code itself
(its order list, takeoff, bid-assist hours and staff bid editor). `test/cvs.mjs` imports every file here and checks
that its lines match the package one for one, then asserts each file's own numbers. The labeled synthetic stand-ins in
`../cvs-synthetic/` still cover edge cases the real files don't (a version 2 package, an unknown module, units > 1).

| File | What it is | Exporter | Checked |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cvs-shower-neenan-hall.json` | Tub-to-shower conversion from a supplier's showroom (Neenan) | Addendum 1 (some fixture ids carry a counter) | 29 materials, 6 on Neenan, haul-away not ordered, 22 on the home center; 8 labor lines, 65.5 hr mid (47 low, 84 high); 11 typical-size lines; glass finish + tile quantity diff and change order |
| `cvs-bathroom-ferguson-luxury.json` | Whole primary bathroom from a supplier (Ferguson Home) | Addendum 1 | 69 materials, 24 on Ferguson Home; 20 labor lines, 263.5 hr mid; photo and typed measurements kept, a measured one replaces the photo one |
| `cvs-roof-timbercrest.json` | Re-roof and gutters from a contractor's own exterior design (TimberCrest), no labor | Addendum 1 | 16 materials on the preferred roofing supplier, no supplier named after the contractor; pack labor and fees, asks for the roof pitch; 8 report/measured measurements kept above lower-ranked ones |
| `cvs-shower-neenan-3options.json` | The Neenan shower as 3 options (panels / tile / walk-in) | Current (stable ids) | Good / Better / Best; re-import with one finish changed shows exactly one difference; fits a `#cvs=d:` link (end-to-end test opens it) |
| `cvs-bathroom-ferguson-luxury-v2.json` | The Ferguson bathroom again | Current (stable ids, concept notice) | 69 materials, 20 labor lines (253.25 hr mid); E1 and E3 price handling is tested on a copy with prices added |
| `cvs-roof-bid-timbercrest-3options.json` | An exterior staff bid: 3 options with priced `workItems` (E2), the takeoff as `materials`, option totals, a fictional customer | Current | Each option's price equals its `total` (Better includes a stated $250 discount); takeoff on the order list, not in the price; no pack labor |

Don't edit these files by hand; a test that needs a variation changes a copy in memory.
